Unknown/masked/uncertain, explicit arithmetic, foreign conflicts, multiple monetary tokens and ranges retain their earlier decisions before this new single-token calendar branch.

The parser returns not_money, classifier maps this to definite not_monetary, and the existing whole-source continuation guard shares the same helper to prevent a quote clipped before 年 from creating a precise amount.
